subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is: **about.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The preposition **"about" **is used here to indicate the subject of traditional sources of information.
 
• **"About"** is commonly used before subjects of information or topics of texts.

Therefore, the sentence correctly reads: "Most of our traditional sources of information **about** the Old Kingdom..."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"On," "off," **and** "at"** do not grammatically fit the context of the sentence.
